device.text: Bootloader and firmware are cryptographically signed; secure boot is enabled.
JTAG/SWD debug ports are present but require an internal jumper to enable.

system.text: The sensor reports level over 4-20 mA/HART to a plant DCS; it is not the sole overfill safety device but contributes to it.

environment.text: Installed on a tank in a fenced process area; physical access is restricted but not eliminated.
Bluetooth commissioning is reachable within ~10 m during maintenance.

operational.text: Commissioning passwords are often left at default; firmware is updated rarely (15-20 year lifetime).

attacker.name: Opportunistic proximity attacker
attacker.text: Within Bluetooth range during maintenance; uses public tooling.

attacker.name: Malicious insider
attacker.text: Has physical access to the enclosure and wiring.

attacker.name: Remote network adversary
attacker.text: Reaches the device only if Ethernet-APL is fitted and routable.
